writer.revision_note: Revision 1 answers the review's five corrections. C1: the FAQ's four keep_alive forms are now listed including '0'. C2: each configuration gets a fresh server on the same port (11435), stopped between phases. C3: run.sh is unchanged and is no longer offered as the config-A runner; Reproduce it now gives the exact probe.py invocation (A_ka0_max3, keep_alive 0, six calls, max-loaded 3) and results_configA.jsonl is described as the original separate invocation.
